text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Tomorrow... is the day I have lunch with 
Big Sis Groove.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(In that case, I'll keep breakfast 
light... and leave the dinner menu 
undecided, so I can eat whatever I want 
for lunch.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Since we're here, I'd rather eat the 
same thing as you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...Well, if it's a lunch she chose, the 
nutritional balance is probably already 
perfect from the start.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...Even so. It makes me want to do 
everything I can for tomorrow.)
